user.title: ELAN DTNR
user.description: Pick the DTNR's serial port, or type a TCP serial bridge as socket://HOST:PORT (for an stunnel client, ser2net or similar). The tuner runs at 19200 baud, 8N1.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't open the port or connect to the bridge.
error.no_response: Connected, but the DTNR didn't answer a query. Check the cable (straight-through, not null-modem), the baud rate on any bridge (19200) and that the unit is powered.

abort.already_configured: This port is already set up.

store_preset.name: Store preset
store_preset.description: Stores the station the tuner is on in one of its 30 presets for the current band.
